Minakuchi's infantry: two platoons. A double-column interlinear note (warichu) gives the composition — one platoon = 50 men, and separately 28 men from the platoon commander down — so the arm totals 2×50 + 28 = 128. MASTER transcribes 外隊長二十八人 (dropping 以下) and parses 100, counting only the two platoons and omitting the 28-man command element.

大德寺
大徳寺（だいとくじ）

Daitoku-ji — the temple named as holder of the 29.3-koku parcel measured in the same column above. Printed with the wide letter-spacing the survey uses for an attribution at the foot of a column (大 / 德 / 寺 separated by ~190 px of blank). The ink is as dark as the main text (5th-percentile 29 vs 28), so this is printed matter, not facing-page bleed-through. The survey states the name without glossing the relationship to the domain.

正税五ヶ年平均 六石八斗四升一合六勺
正税五ヶ年平均（せいぜいごかねんへいきん）六石八斗四升一合六勺（ろっこくはっとよんしょういちごうろくしゃく）

Five-year average of the regular land tax on the Daitoku-ji holding: 6.8416 koku (6 koku 8 to 4 shō 1 gō 6 shaku; sub-units run strictly descending). Against the 29.3-koku assessment above, an effective rate of about 23%. Indented two registers, so subordinate to the 高 column it follows. This is the only 正税五ヶ年平均 on the leaf; it is not in MASTER, and it is not to be confused with MASTER's mislabelled 壬生藩 row (see 檢地出高新田改出込高).

壹萬九千六十一石九斗四升一勺 檢地出高新田改出込高
一万九千六十一石九斗四升一勺（いちまんきゅうせんろくじゅういちこくきゅうとよんしょういちしゃく）〈検地出高（けんちでだか）・新田改出込高（しんでんあらためでだかこみだか）〉

19,061.9401 koku of yield beyond the formal kokudaka: land disclosed by cadastral re-survey (檢地出高) together with newly reclaimed paddy brought onto the books at the new-field revision (新田改出込高), included in the gross figure. The column carries no heading; its identity comes from the double-column warichu printed beneath the value (right sub-run 檢地出高新, left sub-run 田改出込高), so value and note are boxed as one unit. MASTER labels this row 正租五ヶ年平均 (a tax field) — that is wrong: 30,000 + 19,061.9401 = 49,061.9401 = the printed 草高 exactly, and the warichu names the field outright. The genuine 正税五ヶ年平均 on this leaf belongs to Minakuchi (6.8416 koku).
檢地出高新田改出込高
